decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details of the open space as shown on submitted drawing numbers WT838 L01 Rev D, WT838 L03 Rev B, WT838 L04 Rev A, WT838 L05 Rev A, WT838 L06, Plan Record Playground Equipment Ltd ref:Q18744, specification for landscaping and landscape management/maintenance plan, received 1st November 2006 are acceptable in showing that a satisfactory landscaped public open space would be provided, in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-N.1.10 (Provision of New Local Open Space), ENV-N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), C.5.3 (Outdoor Recreation), and C.5.6 (access Routes), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (open space layout) of planning permission dated 15/03/2004.
